question: What status does the attainment of the eight powers hold within the root Kaula?
premises: The eight powers are specified as the object of attainment.
This attainment is identified with the root Kaula.
The identification is addressed directly to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific list of the eight powers is not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula.
